topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I noticed the subtle shifts in the neighborhood since the Joneses moved in. The unassuming car, the quiet demeanor, the occasional flash of something that indicated more than meets the eye. It was the gardener who let it slip. "Did you know they own half of Silicon Valley?" he whispered, eyes wide. I didn't react much, just a nod. It's funny how people want to keep things under wraps, thinking it'll change how others see them. It doesn't. The house is still the same, the smiles genuine. Only now, there's a layer to peel back. But I don't rush; there's no need. I'll let them have their secrets. After all, wealth or not, we're all just trying to get through each day.
